xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above audited financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 3rd November 2026 and the limited review of the same has been carried out by the statutory auditors of the company.
2. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles of applicable Indian Accounting Standards (‘Ind AS’) notified under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 as specified in section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013.
3. Exceptional item for the quarter and year ended 31 March 2026 represents provision made by the Company’s subsidiary in Netherlands towards the ultimate loss (net of recovery from insurance/legal process) related to the unauthorised bank transfer matter reported earlier.
4. During the quarter ended 30th June 2026, the Company has incorporated a 50:50 joint venture with Filmax Corporation, Korea, namely ‘Filmax Cosmo Korea Limited’, to undertake the distribution, sale and marketing of flexible packaging and other products manufactured by the two joint venture partners. Both parties have subscribed to the initial paid-up share capital of the joint venture entity.
5. In July 2026, the US subsidiary received a refund of about USD 6.97 million post the reversal of additional custom duty imposed during the financial year ended 31 March, 2026 on import from India into the USA. Considering the current status of refunds to customers, USD 3.31 million has been provisionally appropriated, of which USD 2.61 million has been appropriated to other income and remaining USD 0.70 million has been adjusted against the carrying value of the underlying inventories. Accordingly, profit before and after tax for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 are higher by Rs.24.81 Cr and Rs.18.23 Cr respectively. Final appropriation of the refund will be determined upon settlement of the refunds to customers.
6. The Holding company has elected to exercise the option permitted under section 200 of the Income Tax Act, 2025 starting from the Tax Year 2026-27. Accordingly, the estimated annual effective tax rate’ for Tax Year 2026-27 has been revised to reflect the impact of the aforesaid election. The income tax expense for the half year ended 30 September, 2026 has been recognised based on the revised estimated annual effective tax rate. Any consequential adjustment arising from the finalisation of the tax computation for the year, if any, will be recognised in the financial results for the last quarter of the current financial year.
7. The details are mentioned in the outcome of board meeting in pdf format.
8. Figures for the previous period have been regrouped wherever required.

Special note:
The figure of Rs. 0.15 crore reflected under Exceptional Items represents the Company's share of profit/(loss) from the Joint Venture. To align the Profit Before Tax figure with the amount reported in the PDF, this amount has been presented in the Exceptional Items column.
